features.title: The workspace
features.intro: The window, its dockers, the look of the app, projects and the files they hold.

groups.title: The window and the menu bar

items.name: Dockers in one window
items.text: the left dock (system stats and settings), References, Assets, the centre dockers (Preview, Timeline, StoryBoard, Music, Stems, SFX, Image editor, ComfyUI, Prompt, Prompt chat, Console), the Queue and the Gallery

items.name: The menu bar
items.text: New project, open, save, screenshot, record, recycle bin, reset project, settings and eject every loaded model, in one row that stays put whichever docks are shown
items.where: the row under the title bar

items.name: Search in dropdown lists
items.text: every list with 8 or more items opens with a search box: type to narrow it (word starts, then the letters in order), arrows and Enter to pick, a letter opens it searching
items.where: every dropdown list; Settings > General > Dropdown lists

items.name: Statusbar docker buttons
items.text: every docker has a button that is lit while it is on screen (open or collapsed); a click hides it, another shows it again

items.name: System stats
items.text: live readings of the computer, with a frame and graphs (temperature, VRAM) for each graphics card

items.name: Power draw and clock speeds
items.text: each graphics card's watts (to its limit) and clocks, the CPU's clock (and power where the computer reports it), the energy since start

items.name: The energy a job used
items.text: Wh / kWh (graphics cards + CPU where it can be read), average and peak watts, on the job's log, its card and the project's job list

items.name: Eject models
items.text: unloads every loaded model to free the graphics card

items.name: Frameless app window
items.text: the studio opens as its own window with a custom title bar instead of a browser tab; the browser still works

items.name: The Console
items.text: the live log of ComfyUI, the workers and every job

items.name: The ComfyUI docker
items.text: ComfyUI's own interface framed inside the studio, with reload and open-in-a-browser buttons

items.name: Tooltips everywhere, Expert mode
items.text: every button has a tooltip; Expert mode hides the help paragraphs once you know your way around

items.name: Space pauses anywhere
items.text: Space pauses the canvas, the live preview or a video in the Preview docker, unless you are typing

items.name: Media viewer
items.text: click any thumbnail to open it full-window: slide through the list, zoom at the pointer, pan, play videos and sounds, open the original

items.name: Render details in the viewer
items.text: the preview dialog shows a picture's or clip's seed, CFG, steps, sampler, model, LoRAs, size, render time and prompt

items.name: Maximize docked or floating
items.text: the Sketcher, Timeline and Image editor: docked, ⛶ fills the column's height and pushes the dockers below down; floating, ⛶ takes the whole window and closes the other dockers (back on restore). The Sketcher has its own resizable height in the column

items.name: Collapse and maximize
items.text: every docker collapses to its header or is maximized; the others stay open at their own height, Esc restores

items.name: Pins
items.text: a pin keeps a dock's height (or a side dock's width) as it is now; it can be made smaller but not taller
items.where: the first button in each dock's header

items.name: The remembered layout
items.text: every dock's state, height, width, pin and maximize are kept in docker_status.json and loaded before anything paints

items.name: Docker configs
items.text: save a layout for each set of dockers you open together (sizes, which are on screen, the side docks and the floating panels), up to six screen sizes per set, loaded automatically
items.where: the Docker layout button at the right of the menu bar

items.name: Floating prompt docker
items.text: the prompt docker floats as its own window; drag, resize, collapse, or dock it above, below or beside another docker

items.name: Floating Basic Settings and LLM tokens
items.text: both are dockers of their own: float them, dock them as a tab in another docker, beside or inside a column, or in the left docker's list

items.name: Named dockers
items.text: make an empty floating docker with your own name and dock floating panels into it as tabs; it can float over the whole app or stay confined to one docker

items.name: ▣ Docker: an empty docker the others drop into
items.text: show it with the statusbar's ▣ Docker or Ctrl+Alt+D, float main dockers with ⇱ and drag them in; an orange line shows where each lands, side by side or stacked, with splitters to size them

items.name: Docker drag-in, Make permanent, Delete
items.text: drag a main docker in by its own title bar; 📌 makes the ▣ docker a regular docker in the main column, 🗑 deletes it and its button; the statusbar button carries its name

items.name: Docker title right-click menu
items.text: right-click a docker you made (floating or permanent) for Rename, its layout, Make permanent / Float it again and Delete docker

items.name: Named docker layouts and titles
items.text: a named docker shows its dockers as tabs, side by side or stacked (⇆ / ⇅ in its title, or ⚙ > Layout); double-click the title to rename it in place

items.name: Dialogs in the middle
items.text: dialogs and message boxes open in the middle of the screen, or where you last moved them

items.name: Panel layout file
items.text: where every floating panel is, its size, name and tabs are kept in panel_layout.cfg

items.name: The StoryBoard floats
items.text: the StoryBoard docker can become a window of its own, dock as a tab in a named docker, or go back under the timeline

items.name: Themes
items.text: Dark, Darker (OLED black), Slate, Light and High contrast change the whole app, image editor included

items.name: Accent colour
items.text: any colour for the buttons, lit tabs and sliders

items.name: UI size
items.text: one slider scales every font and panel together, 60 to 175 %

items.name: Customize colours
items.text: a colour for each part of the theme (background, panels, lines, text, OK, error, hover, canvas, selected)

items.name: Saved themes
items.text: save a theme as a .json in the themes folder, load it from its card, export and import it; an import keeps the theme you had as <name>_old.json, saves the imported one at once, and ↶ Revert goes back (2.709.0)

items.name: Edit theme mode
items.text: click any element on screen to pick it and change its font, size, colours, shadows, corner radius or icon, for this element, all like it, or its whole kind
items.where: the brush button in the top bar

items.name: Dialogs keep working in edit theme mode
items.text: dialogs and popup menus take clicks and keys as usual while the mode is on

items.name: Editor themes
items.text: the image editor follows the app theme, or its own Pro, Studio or Classic look

items.name: Projects
items.text: everything lives in its own project folder: outputs, video, images, sound, characters and scenes
items.where: the menu bar's New, Open and Save

items.name: Save keeps everything
items.text: the song and scenes, prompt, chat, characters, environments, references, assets, gallery, timeline and each docker's fields

items.name: Save as
items.text: copies the whole project under a new name and opens the copy; an existing name is refused

items.name: New project starts fresh
items.text: the project you leave is saved first, then every docker starts empty

items.name: Recycle bin
items.text: deleted files go to the project's recycle bin; restore them, delete them for good or empty the bin

items.name: Reset project
items.text: empties the project and makes it again with the same name, stopping its renders and clearing its finished jobs

items.name: Whole-project file (.bgp)
items.text: the whole project as one XML file, self-contained with its media or as a small manifest, streamed so gigabytes are fine; opening one makes a new project
items.where: the package button in the menu bar

items.name: Movie bundles
items.text: New, Save and Load whole movies on the StoryBoard (cast, chapters, scenes and renders)

items.name: Assets dock
items.text: the project's images, videos and sounds; drop files on it to import them

items.name: Asset groups
items.text: (2.635.0: a group is a FOLDER of the Assets folder) sort files into groups; Send moves the file into the folder, Add links it there too

items.name: SolidCraft full window
items.text: ⛶ on the SolidCraft docker fills the whole window (title bar and status bar stay) and closes the other dockers; 🗗 / Esc brings the layout back as it was

items.name: Shift+right-click leaves Artist mode
items.text: out of the image editor's canvas-only Artist mode with Shift+right-click anywhere (no context menu); Ctrl+Esc / Ctrl+Shift+F still work

items.name: bitGen Default theme + Ctrl+Alt+S
items.text: Ctrl+Alt+S opens Settings from anywhere; Ctrl+Alt+Shift+T, ⟲ bitGen Default or ?theme=default puts the built-in default theme back (Dark, no element styles, UI size 100 %), ↶ The theme before undoes it; the built-in theme can't be overwritten or deleted

items.name: Global and project assets
items.text: 📁 Project | 🌐 Global | All in the Assets dock; project assets in projects/<name>/Assets, global ones (every project) in projects/Assets; uploads go into Assets; right-click 🌐 Move to Global / 📁 Move to Project

items.name: Select and delete assets
items.text: tick, Ctrl-click or Shift-click tiles; delete moves them to the recycle bin, never a hard delete

items.name: Add tiles
items.text: dashed add tiles open the file dialog to add pictures, videos or sounds, several at once

items.name: References dock
items.text: pictures, videos and sounds that ride the next generation; drag them in from the Assets or the Gallery

items.name: Gallery
items.text: every render, with tabs for images, videos and audio; drag from it onto references, the timeline or a scene

items.name: The queue
items.text: one job at a time on the graphics card; pause, reorder, abort and retry, every job with its log

items.name: Pending and Done tabs
items.text: queued, running and interrupted jobs apart from finished ones, saved with the project; resume an interrupted job

items.name: One running card
items.text: the running render shows as one card with its prompt, mode, size, progress bar and chunk / step / time

items.name: Clear finished jobs
items.text: removes every done, failed and cancelled job from the list without deleting files

items.name: Abort dialog
items.text: stop this render, retry it at the front of the queue, or stop everything

items.name: Seeds to reuse
items.text: every finished job's details, with a button to put its seed back in Basic Settings

items.name: Live ComfyUI progress
items.text: every video job shows which node is running and "step n of total"
items.where: the Queue, scene cards and the Generate button

groups.title: The file dialog and Save as

items.name: bitGen's own file dialog
items.text: Quick access, the app and project folders, every drive with its free space, an address bar, search with wildcards, details or large icons, new folder and rename; the same on Windows, macOS and Linux
items.where: every folder button and Choose file

items.name: Save as from the gallery
items.text: every gallery tile has a save-as icon that opens the file dialog in Save As mode

items.name: Quick save
items.text: Save in the preview dialog copies the file to the last save-as folder without a dialog, never overwriting

items.name: Screenshot
items.text: saves the app window or the whole screen to the gallery

items.name: Screen recording
items.text: records the app or the screen as an H.264 mp4, with computer sound, microphone and a countdown

items.name: Use it from your phone
items.text: a QR-code remote link: the phone takes photos and video, sends audio and talks to the model; everything lands in the project

items.name: Audio visualiser
items.text: any sound that plays fills the preview with a live visualisation (spectrum, wave, rings, particles, spectrogram)

items.name: 360-degree player
items.text: a look-around view of any equirectangular video: drag to look, wheel to zoom

items.name: The installer
items.text: one installer per system sets up Node.js, Python, ComfyUI, the node packs and the models, tuned for your graphics card

items.name: The public beta repository
items.text: the source with a README, the changelog of every release, contributing and security guides, issue templates and automatic tests on every push (scripts/ci-units.sh); docs/BETA.md says what is experimental and how to report a problem

items.name: Model catalog
items.text: downloads the models each feature needs (video, image editing, upscaling, 3D models, Viggle and more), with a Hugging Face token and the Hugging Face CLI for big files

items.name: Node packs
items.text: installs the ComfyUI custom node packs; a missing one is named with its pack when a job starts

items.name: Local LLM
items.text: pick a model, start and stop its server, and rescan the folder; the running model is picked on start

items.name: LLM tokens
items.text: a live estimate of the prompt's tokens and a reply-budget slider

items.name: Free VRAM before every generation
items.text: avoids most out-of-memory failures when mixing images, music and video

items.name: Video accelerators
items.text: Sage attention, Spectrum and Comfy Kitchen speed-ups per video style, with one-click installs
items.where: Settings > ComfyUI and the video style

items.name: Wire any ComfyUI graph
items.text: load a workflow, convert it to an API prompt, add your own toggles, dropdowns, sliders and text boxes and wire them to its values

items.name: Graph mode
items.text: run a wired graph from Generate with the controls you made; its load nodes fill themselves from the reference dock

items.name: Workflow conversion
items.text: a UI workflow is turned into an API prompt (subgraphs and Set / Get nodes unfolded), now with ComfyUI's own frontend

items.name: Model file matching
items.text: model files a workflow names are matched to the ones your ComfyUI has, and the job log says so

items.name: Settings > 3D
items.text: the engine for parametric 3D bodies and the Unreal Engine bridge settings

features.title: Generating video
features.intro: From a single prompt to a whole film: the prompt docker, the video models, references, characters and the StoryBoard.

items.name: One Generate button
items.text: the dropdown under it says what it makes: video, image, music, speech, a wired graph or a chat reply

items.name: Generate, Edit, Refine, Fill, Replace background, Remove
items.text: in Image mode a dropdown on the menu bar says what Generate does to the picture in the image editor, like the Krita AI plugin; Refine gets a strength slider and the button's words follow the choice

items.name: References or layers
items.text: with the image editor closed, Edit, Refine, Replace background and Compose use the References docker's pictures (Fill and Remove leave the list); with it open, they use the selected layer, or several picked layers; a chip says which

items.name: Compose
items.text: one picture from up to three pictures: the layers picked in the image editor, or the References docker's pictures

items.name: Generate modes
items.text: Ref (reference pictures), F/L (first / last frame), Text, and Swap

items.name: Several jobs from one prompt
items.text: /br/ on its own line splits the prompt into jobs that run one after another

items.name: Enter improves the prompt
items.text: Enter sends the prompt to the local LLM, which rewrites it

items.name: One prompt docker for every tool
items.text: the image editor's AI, the timeline's Fill, path layers, AI scenes, the 3D look, characters, environments and VR worlds all take their words from the prompt docker

items.name: Negative prompt docker
items.text: what the picture must not have, sent with every generation; its status says whether the chosen model uses it, and the LLM's "Negative:" lines land there
items.where: key 2, or Negative in the statusbar

items.name: Quick prompts
items.text: save a prompt by its first line and pick it again from a list

items.name: Generate progress
items.text: the running job's step count above the button and a progress bar under it

items.name: Clear the prompt
items.text: empties the prompt box only

items.name: Dictation
items.text: Speak records from the microphone and adds the words to the prompt

groups.title: The prompt chat and the local LLM

items.name: Prompt chat
items.text: talk through an idea with the local LLM; prompts in its replies become blocks you can render straight away

items.name: Save, load and clear chats
items.text: a chat is saved as "subject - date" and listed newest first; clear wipes the window and the model's memory

items.name: The LLM sees your references
items.text: pictures in tray order with a one-line description from the local vision model, the videos and the sounds, so it writes prompts with the right tags

items.name: Model-specific prompting
items.text: with an LTX or Wan style picked the LLM writes for that model

items.name: Speech prompts shaped for MiniMax H3
items.text: spoken lines are put into H3's dialogue syntax with the language and the voice timbre; stray instructions are tidied away

items.name: Read replies aloud
items.text: speaks each answer with the chosen voice

items.name: Longform shot lists
items.text: asked for something longer than one clip, the LLM writes a numbered shot list that chains

items.name: 360 and stereo VR prompting
items.text: the LLM is taught equirectangular and side-by-side stereo prompt rules when you ask for them

items.name: Basic Settings
items.text: mode, resolution, aspect, seconds, steps, CFG, seed, format, LoRAs, ControlNet and face fix

items.name: Seeds
items.text: -1 for a random seed, a number for that seed, a dice for random again, a button for the last seed used

items.name: Temporary LoRAs
items.text: extra LoRAs added on top of the style's for the next renders

items.name: Video style card
items.text: the picked video style with its model per phase, steps, CFG, encoder, VAE, LoRAs and negative; change a model there and it is saved into the style

items.name: Override style
items.text: Basic Settings decide steps, CFG, seed, model and extra LoRAs for every video model (MiniMax H3, Wan, LTX)

items.name: Video styles
items.text: a saved model set and workflow per mode, with phases for models that sample in stages; duplicate one to keep variants

items.name: Three ways to render
items.text: reference pictures (up to nine), first / last frame, or text alone, with native sound

items.name: Long clips joined seamlessly
items.text: a clip longer than one run is split and joined

items.name: Long video: one run up to 30 s
items.text: low-VRAM attention and chunked feed-forward let a MiniMax H3 clip of up to 30 seconds render in ONE generation instead of joined 15-second pieces
items.where: the StoryBoard's ⚙ (Long video), or the MiniMax H3 Long (30 s) video style

items.name: More ComfyUI packs one click away
items.text: install or update KJNodes, Yusu H3 Unified and RH DLSS 5

items.name: Veda sparse attention
items.text: an optional MiniMax H3 accelerator in a video style (On / Quality): about 2-3x faster than stock attention at its trained sizes, with a one-click install and its predictor in the model catalog
items.where: Settings > Video styles; Settings > ComfyUI > Video accelerators

items.name: The model manager for hundreds of models
items.text: pages that fit the docker, folder tabs (SDXL, Pony …), a 📌 This project tab, resizable cards, an info page per model with its example pictures and prompts, and Civitai details + thumbnails + examples for every model kept in one shared model_info folder

items.name: Civitai into each type's folder
items.text: ⤓ on any Civitai card downloads into the folder you picked once for that type (SDXL LoRAs, Pony models, Wan LoRAs …); Shift+click changes it; 📁 lists them (model_folders.json); 🔄 Sync fetches Civitai's details for every model on the computer

items.name: Reference descriptions
items.text: a short description under every reference picture, video and sound, kept with the project and groups, used in the mapping lines, the prompt chat and ✨ Enhance; wall / floor / furniture / light picture types

items.name: References in the image editor
items.text: a dropped reference becomes a layer; ✨ Edit can take a reference as Picture 2

items.name: Renders made real with references
items.text: each Blender / Unreal object is matched to a reference picture, by its name or by hand. The first frame is made real with those pictures by an edit model, then LTX 2.3 3DREAL animates it along the render
items.where: 🟧 Timeline Blender scene / UNREAL ▸ Render to Real, 🖼 image editor 3D and Unreal layers

items.name: Add-ons
items.text: Settings ▸ Add-ons lists the optional engines (YuE2 music, Viggle native): what each is for, needs and size, and whether it is installed; ⤓ Install / ⟳ Reinstall / 🗑 Remove with the log in the tab

items.name: ⟳ Reinstall and the install status
items.text: anything already installed says ⟳ Reinstall (a downloaded model ⟳ Download again) and fetches everything again; while an install or download runs its button is disabled and a status beside it shows the step, the percentage and the seconds, then ✓ or ✗ with the reason
items.where: Settings (Add-ons, Audio, ComfyUI, Models, Extensions), the model catalog, Civitai, the LoRA trainer and the dockers' install buttons

items.name: Update from GitHub
items.text: Settings ▸ General ▸ ⟳ Updates: check GitHub for a newer version (the new commits listed), ⤓ Update now (a git clone moves to GitHub's branch with your changed files backed up; a zip install gets the changed files), npm / pip when their lists changed, ⟳ Restart now; a quiet check after start

items.name: A tidy app folder
items.text: the app folder holds start.bat (+ package.json, README, LICENSE); the server, the workers, the settings defaults, the setup scripts and the notes are in misc\; an install updated from a zip tidies its old copies away at the first start (quick prompts kept)

items.name: Maximize beside the side dockers
items.text: ⛶ fills the room between the open Gallery / Queue / References / Assets / left docker

items.name: Picture types
items.text: mark a reference picture as person, face, clothing, first frame or last frame; a first frame switches the render to first / last frame

items.name: True CFG
items.text: CFG above 1 adds a negative pass that strengthens only what your prompt adds

items.name: H3 size
items.text: choose how sizes between H3's 32-pixel steps are handled: round down, or render larger and crop back exactly

items.name: Speech with emotion in a character's voice
items.text: each line carries its emotion and is spoken in the character's cloned voice; long voice clips are trimmed to an 8-second sample

items.name: Other languages
items.text: a language tag in the quotes speaks the line in that language

items.name: H3_Viggle style
items.text: a motion video drives the movement and a picture says who performs it

items.name: LTX 2.5 modes
items.text: text, image, first / last frame, first / middle / last, lip sync, first / last lip sync, audio to video and video to video (style transfer); Auto picks by what the reference dock holds

items.name: ⏱ Timed lines (Prompt Relay)
items.text: [0-2s] … lines in an LTX prompt give each stretch of the clip its own words in one render, untimed lines cover the whole clip; ⏱ adds the next line
items.where: the prompt docker with an LTX style, StoryBoard scenes, the timeline's AI clip (Settings ▸ Add-ons ▸ Nougan Nodes)

items.name: Transition LoRA
items.text: switched on automatically for the modes that travel between pictures

items.name: Official templates
items.text: text, image and first / last frame run on ComfyUI's own templates with only built-in nodes

items.name: LTX on the StoryBoard
items.text: each scene's card decides the mode, with or without the board's song

items.name: LTX 2.3 modes
items.text: text, image, first / last frame and 3D render to real

items.name: 3D render to real (3DREAL)
items.text: a render from Blender, a game or any CG clip becomes photoreal with the same layout and camera move; strong v2, strong or light variants

items.name: Wan modes
items.text: text, image to video, first and last frame, and a character reference (VACE)

items.name: Graph built for you
items.text: bitGen builds the Wan graph from ComfyUI's own nodes and picks the right model files by name

items.name: 24 fps output
items.text: Wan's 16 fps is motion-interpolated to 24 fps to join your other clips; the reference dock's first sound is laid under it

items.name: Reference videos and sounds
items.text: up to three of each ride a reference render; missing slots are added to the workflow when needed

items.name: Choose the frames of a reference video
items.text: a looping preview, a zoomable filmstrip and a selection box; Apply cuts exactly those frames

items.name: Append / Prepend
items.text: render a new part that starts on the video's last frame (or ends on its first) and joins it, always as first / last frame

items.name: Timeline capture
items.text: the playhead's frame from any layer becomes a first frame, last frame or reference

items.name: Qwen Image 2.1 reads the dock
items.text: pictures are sent in order and named in the prompt from their types

items.name: Characters
items.text: a name, details, a character sheet (front / side / back) and a voice clip; its @tag brings the sheet and voice into prompts

items.name: A character from one picture
items.text: upload a photo or render and a reference sheet is generated

items.name: Actors
items.text: choose who is in the current scene

items.name: Clothing and identity models
items.text: clothing entries follow the character; each keeps a dataset folder for identity models

items.name: 360-degree environments
items.text: locations as panoramas with a camera and a scene range, projected to a flat view for continuity

items.name: Create screenplay
items.text: describe a story and the LLM writes the scenes, with the characters speaking their lines

items.name: Scene count
items.text: type how many scenes, or let the project, your request or the LLM decide

items.name: How each scene follows
items.text: Ref (a new shot), First (exactly on a frame of the take before), Cont (that frame with the cast sheets), Trans (from that frame to the new location)

items.name: Render a scene or the selected ones
items.text: rendering continues in the background while you edit
items.where: the scene's play button, Render selected

items.name: Filmstrip
items.text: click a frame of a take to make it the next scene's first frame

items.name: The take bar
items.text: watch, keep, redo, swap the character, or upscale a take

items.name: Make a first frame
items.text: Qwen Image 2.1 makes a scene's opening picture from the characters, a location and props

items.name: Compile
items.text: joins the rendered takes into one film in scene order

items.name: The Scenes dropdown
items.text: the board in a dropdown, with a scene picker showing each scene's state

items.name: Scene progress
items.text: "rendering step n of total" with a bar and time on each card

items.name: Render settings
items.text: size, steps, LoRAs, accelerators, the upscaler and the tail frames

items.name: Scene seeds
items.text: random for each scene or one seed for all; each card has its own seed box

items.name: Render size
items.text: the StoryBoard setting, else Basic Settings, else the app default; the job notes say which

items.name: StoryBoard pictures
items.text: a picture per scene from its prompt with any image model, using character sheets, locations and references; use it as the first or last frame

items.name: Make all missing pictures
items.text: renders every scene picture that is not there yet

items.name: The info line
items.text: the StoryBoard's latest message, in full on hover

items.name: Motion slot
items.text: with H3_Viggle, each scene takes a motion video

items.name: Load a song
items.text: its waveform opens auto-segmented; one scene per segment

items.name: Create music video
items.text: the writer uses the song's segments as scenes and makes the characters sing

items.name: Lip sync per scene
items.text: every scene lip-syncs its own window of the song

items.name: The transcript decides
items.text: a timed transcript of the song says which scenes are sung and puts the words in the prompt

items.name: Scenes at their song time
items.text: each take lands on the timeline at the time its part of the song starts

items.name: Bridge scenes
items.text: short transitions between song segments, rendered by the model or drawn as standard transitions

items.name: Swap a character in footage
items.text: a new person in existing footage; the performance, camera, background and sound stay

items.name: Swap a take
items.text: swap the character of a rendered scene into its next take

items.name: The Swap dialog
items.text: for whole movies: load a video of any length, auto-segment it, swap each piece, keep and compile

items.name: Swap quality
items.text: Full, Best or Fast

items.name: Write prompt
items.text: the vision model and LLM write a swap prompt from the picture and the video

items.name: LTX Ripple engine
items.text: a first frame with the new character carried through the clip

items.name: Viggle engines
items.text: Viggle-Animate through ComfyUI, or bitGen's own native engine that keeps the model loaded between segments

items.name: Several first frames
items.text: make up to four first frames per segment and pick one

items.name: Safe mode
items.text: a black take is rendered again with everything that can blacken it switched off

items.name: VR swap
items.text: swaps a person in 360 or 180-degree footage through a virtual camera; stereo eyes rebuilt from depth

items.name: VR World
items.text: a performer inside a 360 or 180-degree picture: aim the camera, add the performer's pictures, sound and prompt, render with VR metadata

items.name: Lock the background
items.text: outside the performer both eyes show the picture itself

items.name: SeedVR2 upscaling
items.text: upscale a video to 720p-4K or by a factor, with colour match, temporal split and denoise

items.name: Keyframes on any setting
items.text: a ◇ beside every colour, effect, mask, text and time setting keys it at the playhead (then changing it keys it); the Graph Editor shows them and the compile matches
items.where: ◇ in a clip's Properties and the 🎨 Colour dialog

items.name: Edit theme mode: resize, move, hide, rename
items.text: drag handles to resize an element, drag it to move it, hide it or change its text; every change is kept in themes/<name>.tmp, and leaving edit mode offers Save theme, Save theme as…, Reset theme, Not now or Cancel

items.name: Edit theme mode: every button and its words
items.text: double-click any words (buttons, docker titles, tabs, labels, headings, hints) to change them in place; rename a dropdown's options; change placeholders and tooltips; the floating tool panels are edited like the dockers; Shift+click (2.682.0) or Alt+click runs a button's action and opens sections / tabs / menus without leaving the mode

items.name: Hidden in Expert mode
items.text: a theme can hide an element only while Expert mode is on; Basic mode still shows it
items.where: edit theme mode > the Style panel > Hide

items.name: Theme edit mode for dialogs
items.text: Ctrl+Shift+Alt+E styles an open dialog (Settings …) too; Ctrl+S saves the theme and leaves

items.name: Folding dockers
items.text: the side dockers fold to a thin title strip; the image editor's docker groups fold to their tabs and close with ✕; View ▸ Dockers shows or hides each one
items.where: ▾ in a docker's title bar; the image editor's View menu

items.name: Motion tracking
items.text: follow a point, two points (scale and rotation), four corners or a flat surface (planar) through a clip to a fraction of a pixel, then apply it to a layer's position or pin a layer into it
items.where: 🎯 Track in a video clip's Properties

items.name: Corner pin
items.text: draw a layer into four corners, tracked or dragged by hand; the compile matches the canvas
items.where: ▢ Corner pin in a layer's Properties

items.name: Bézier masks
items.text: several masks per layer drawn with a pen (corners and curves), with add, subtract, intersect and difference, feather, expansion, opacity, invert and an animated path; pictures, text, shapes and video
items.where: the ✒ Mask Pen (Shift+M) and ✒ Masks in a layer's Properties

items.name: Expressions
items.text: a small formula on a layer property (position, scale, rotation, opacity, anchor, shape and text animator numbers): wiggle, loops, delays, ranges, random, links to other layers; checked as you type; the compile follows it
items.where: ƒx Expressions in a layer's Properties

items.name: Roving keyframes
items.text: a position key's time follows the motion path for an even speed between its neighbours

items.name: Easy Ease
items.text: ease a keyframe in and out, or one side only
items.where: the Properties, F9 (Shift+F9 in, Ctrl+Shift+F9 out)

items.name: Anchor point
items.text: what position places and scale and rotation turn about; keyframable; the layer stays put when you move it

items.name: Curved motion paths
items.text: the position path drawn on the canvas with Bézier handles to bend it; Smooth path in one click

items.name: Parenting
items.text: a picture, text, null or (since 2.495.0) video layer follows another layer's position, rotation and scale; it stays put when the parent is chosen or cleared, and the compile follows it

items.name: Null objects
items.text: empty control layers to key and parent others to; never compiled

items.name: Blend modes
items.text: Multiply, Screen, Overlay, Darken, Lighten, Color Dodge and Burn, Hard and Soft Light, Difference, Exclusion, Add and (since 2.495.0) Hue, Saturation, Color and Luminosity per layer, on the canvas and in the compile

items.name: Track mattes
items.text: show a layer only where the layer above it is (alpha or luma, or inverted); video inside text and the like

items.name: Shape layers
items.text: rectangles, ellipses, stars and polygons drawn with the Shape tool, with a colour or gradient fill and a stroke

items.name: Shape operators
items.text: Trim Paths, Repeater, Offset Paths, Pucker & Bloat, Twist, Zig Zag, Wiggle Paths and Round Corners, every number keyable

items.name: Freehand shapes
items.text: draw a closed shape or an open line by hand, smoothed; Alt adds it to the picked shape layer as another path

items.name: Merge Paths
items.text: several paths in one shape layer combined by add, subtract, intersect or exclude, holes included; the operators after it work on the merged outline
items.where: ⧉ Paths and ⊕ Merge Paths in a shape layer's Properties

items.name: Text animators
items.text: move, turn, scale, fade, space out, blur or recolour the letters, words or lines a range selects; Typewriter, Fade up, Pop in, Slide in, Wave and Blur in presets; every number keyable
items.where: ✨ Text Animators in a text layer's Properties

items.name: Text on a path
items.text: the letters run along an arc, circle, wave or a shape layer's outline, turned to it; the start is keyable
items.where: 〰 On a path in a text layer's Properties

items.name: Edit a keyframe
items.text: click a diamond on a clip for its opacity, volume, place, scale, rotation, colour and ease

items.name: Drag and delete keyframes
items.text: drag along the clip; right-click, Alt-click or Delete removes one

items.name: Volume keyframes
items.text: on sound clips too

items.name: Effect keyframes
items.text: blur, sharpen, glow, vignette, grain and crop move from key to key

items.name: Ripple, Roll, Slip and Slide
items.text: trim and move everything after, move a cut, show other frames, or slide between neighbours
items.where: keys V, B, N, Y, U

items.name: Split
items.text: split at the position marker

items.name: Track targets
items.text: split every targeted layer at once
items.where: the target in each layer header

items.name: J / K / L shuttle
items.text: play backwards or forwards at 2x, 4x, 8x; step a frame

items.name: Edit points and ends
items.text: previous or next edit point, the start or the end

items.name: Edits on reversed and ramped clips
items.text: the edit tools and split are frame-exact on retimed clips

items.name: Markers
items.text: named, coloured flags with comments; next and previous marker

items.name: Marker ranges and clip markers
items.text: markers with a length, and markers that stay on a clip's frame

items.name: Timecode
items.text: HH:MM:SS:FF with a start and frame rate; drop-frame at 29.97 and 59.94

items.name: Speed
items.text: 10 to 1000 %, with the clip's length following

items.name: Reverse and ramps
items.text: play backwards or ramp the speed along the clip

items.name: Slowed frames
items.text: repeat, blend or optical flow

items.name: Reversed sound on the canvas
items.text: a reversed or ramped clip's sound is rendered once and heard in step

items.name: Looks and sliders
items.text: teal and orange, warm film, cool night and more; exposure, contrast, saturation, temperature, tint and hue

items.name: LUTs
items.text: import any 3D .cube LUT and blend it

items.name: Colour wheels and curves
items.text: lift, gamma and gain wheels; master and RGB curves

items.name: HSL secondaries
items.text: up to six hue ranges shifted, saturated or lightened

items.name: Hue curves
items.text: hue vs hue and hue vs saturation

items.name: Scopes
items.text: waveform, RGB parade, vectorscope and histogram

items.name: Colour match
items.text: set a clip's curves to match another clip

items.name: What you see is what you get
items.text: the grade is baked into one table the canvas and compile share

items.name: HDR clips tone-mapped
items.text: a phone's HDR video is tone-mapped into the movie

items.name: Effects
items.text: blur, sharpen, glow, vignette, grain, crop, green / blue screen key and stabilise

items.name: Distort effects
items.text: lens, mirror and warp (wave, twirl)

items.name: Stabilise modes
items.text: smooth or locked, with a steady preview

items.name: Adjustment layers
items.text: colour and effects that work on everything under them

items.name: Masks (power windows)
items.text: an ellipse or box with feather and invert limits the grade and effects

items.name: Tracking
items.text: the mask follows the thing to the clip's end

items.name: Clean-up
items.text: voice clarity, denoise and gain, with a before / after preview

items.name: EQ, multiband and reverb
items.text: on any clip's sound

items.name: J / L cuts
items.text: a clip's sound starts early or runs on late

items.name: Linked sound
items.text: a video's sound as its own linked clip; unlink or bring it back

items.name: Mix dialog
items.text: voice, music and sfx roles, ducking and loudness to a target

items.name: Track mixer
items.text: a fader, pan, mute, solo and live level meter per track and for the master

items.name: Waveforms
items.text: every sound clip shows its waveform

items.name: Captions from speech
items.text: everything that speaks is transcribed locally and placed where each clip sits

items.name: Edit and style captions
items.text: times, words, font, size, colour, outline or box, position

items.name: Burn in or .srt
items.text: burned into the movie and / or an .srt beside it

items.name: Edit by transcript
items.text: choose words, cut them or keep only them; remove pauses and filler words

items.name: Transcript scope
items.text: this clip, its layer or the whole sequence

items.name: Scene cuts
items.text: split a clip where its shots change, or drop markers there

items.name: Multi-camera
items.text: sync angles by sound and cut live with keys 1 to 9; flatten into ordinary clips

items.name: Nested sequences
items.text: another timeline compiled into one clip, re-rendered when it changes

items.name: Proxies
items.text: small copies of heavy footage for playback; the movie uses the originals

items.name: Render bar
items.text: shows which stretches play live, may drop frames, are too heavy, or are rendered

items.name: Render previews
items.text: compile once and play the exact movie at full speed over rendered stretches

items.name: Late-frame counter and playback resolution
items.text: full, half or quarter size while playing

items.name: GPU compositor
items.text: layers composited on the graphics card while playing

items.name: New take
items.text: render a clip again in its own slot and switch between takes

items.name: Extend
items.text: more seconds continuing from a clip's last frame

items.name: B-roll
items.text: fill an empty stretch of V1, or a cutaway over a range

items.name: Cut to the beat
items.text: find a song's beats, then drop markers or cut a clip on them

items.name: Path layers
items.text: draw a path and a subject (animal, person, vehicle) follows it, with size and pace
items.where: the timeline bar's Path layer button

items.name: In place or along the path
items.text: a green-screen clip moved by keyframes, or Wan ATI making it travel itself

items.name: Cut out
items.text: an AI matte or a chroma key; every path layer is see-through

items.name: Camera panel
items.text: presets, pan, tilt, roll, height, dolly and lens keys, with camera, top and side views

items.name: The camera tool
items.text: drag on the canvas to pan, tilt, roll, change height and dolly

items.name: Use in Generate
items.text: each video model is told the move it can follow

items.name: Exact path guide
items.text: a picture with depth flown along the path as a guide video

items.name: 3D text and models
items.text: extruded 3D text or FBX, OBJ, GLB and glTF models, moved and keyframed like any layer

items.name: 3D widgets
items.text: move, rotate and scale in 3D with G, R and S

items.name: Materials and lights
items.text: material presets or your own, studio lights and your own point, spot, sun, ambient and sky lights

items.name: The 3D toolbar
items.text: widget, snap, views, spin, reset, material, lights, key and bake
items.where: along the top of the canvas

items.name: Baked for the compile
items.text: a 3D layer is baked into a see-through video automatically

items.name: Render with Blender
items.text: a 3D layer rendered by Blender for the compile

items.name: Rulers and guidelines
items.text: rulers in picture pixels; drag guidelines out, move them or type their place

items.name: Snapping
items.text: moved layers snap to guidelines, the picture's edges and centre, and the grid

items.name: Grid
items.text: a grid over the preview canvas with its own settings

items.name: Grids and Guides settings
items.text: spacing, major lines, lines or dots, colours and snap distance

items.name: Text effect presets
items.text: layered 3D text looks drawn live as you type; import your own from a PSD

items.name: Presets on animated, on-a-path and 3D text
items.text: a text with a preset keeps it with ✨ Text Animators and 〰 On a path; 3D text takes a preset as its front face (sides in its colour)
items.where: a text's Properties, a 3D text's Properties

items.name: New text with your preset
items.text: the T tool's new text starts with the preset last picked; nothing selected = Properties ▸ New text ▸ Preset

items.name: 🧬 Morph
items.text: one character turns into another between two layers: write both characters, pick the two layers; the prompt is written, the first / last frames are taken, the video model renders it, it lands on a 🧬 Morph layer between them and layer 2 moves to start after it
items.where: the timeline's layers panel ▸ 🧬 Morph tab

items.name: ▯ Frame: click a frame, Del removes it
items.text: a timeline tool that selects single frames on one layer (click, drag for several, Shift+click, ← / →); Del / ⌫ cuts them out of that layer and closes the gap, ↶ puts them back
items.where: the timeline's menu bar ▸ ▯ (or F over the layers)

items.name: A cut clip stays one clip
items.text: ✂ Cut / Del on frames through a clip joins the parts before and after into one continuous clip (a video / sound made into one "-join" file, frame-exact; a picture just shorter); one ↶. The preview loads the next clip a second early, so a cut never flashes black

items.name: ▼ Ranges marked while it plays
items.text: tap Ctrl while the preview plays for a range's start and again for its end, as many as you like on the highlighted layer, each its own colour; drag a ▼ to move it (the preview shows that frame)
items.where: the timeline (Ctrl), ▼ in the time ruler

items.name: Pick ranges, ✂ Cut cuts them
items.text: click a ▼ to pick its range, Ctrl / Shift + click for more; ✂ Cut (and ⏩ / ✕) work on the picked ones, all when none is picked
items.where: the timeline's ruler ▼ + the menu bar's ▼ group

items.name: Basic Settings per style
items.text: every style keeps the Basic Settings you last used with it (misc/basic_settings.tmp): a style change saves the settings for the style you leave first, then puts back the new style's; the app opens on the last styles with their settings. A video style carries everything but the image set; an image style the image set
items.where: any style list (the prompt docker, Basic Settings' style card)

items.name: Setup in colour, never looks stalled
items.text: done green, installing a lighter green (with its time), warnings orange, errors red in the setup window's steps, log and downloads and in the install scripts; a quiet step says it is still working, why it can take long and that it has not stalled

items.name: Install with one file
items.text: install_all.bat / install_all.sh / install_all.command: Git and Node.js installed when missing (Windows: Python too), the repository cloned next to it, then the studio starts (the first start installs the rest)
items.where: the repository's root - download just that file

items.name: Text effects from a zip
items.text: a zip of PSD text effects (a pack) installs every effect in it as a preset in one go, with the fonts it carries; several PSDs can be picked at once too
items.where: a text layer's Properties / the image editor's Type tool ▸ Presets ▾ ＋ Import PSD text effects or a zip…

items.name: Hidden / deleted bridge layers close their bridge
items.text: a Blender, 3D (Daz / Blender) or Unreal layer that is hidden or deleted closes its scene / live view in the image editor and the timeline (the Blender process ends, the Unreal View stops, Daz's waiting commands are dropped)
items.where: the image editor's Layers (👁 / delete), the timeline's layers

items.name: ✂ Cut all ranges / ⏩ Speed up ranges
items.text: cut every marked range at once (a clip cut several times stays one clip), or play each 2× - 10× faster to fast-forward a render

items.name: Hover time + playback speed
items.text: the time under the pointer in a small box over the timeline; the preview plays at 0.125× - 8×
items.where: the timeline; the speed list under the preview

items.name: ✂ to new layer
items.text: a checkbox that puts the part after a cut or a Ctrl+K split on a new layer right above

items.name: Text in a shape layer
items.text: a text stretched to fill a shape layer's outline or flowed inside it (Fit), placed on it; follows an animated shape
items.where: a text's Properties ▸ 🔤 In a shape

items.name: 🅰 Text fill for shape layers
items.text: the shape filled with rows of text (font, size, colour, angle)

items.name: Warp presets on any layer
items.text: 16 presets (Arc … Twist, Wedge) as an editable ⌗ mesh you drag with 📌

items.name: Motion graphics templates
items.text: lower third, title card, end card and corner tag, or save your own

items.name: Tools and Properties docker

items.name: The timeline's CAD toolbar
items.text: a ribbon over the preview row with Create, 3D, Sketch, Solid and Unreal tabs (see CAD and 3D)

items.name: Timeline settings

features.title: The image editor
features.intro: A layered picture editor with selections, retouching, smart objects, type, vector drawing, dimensions, CAD sketches and AI, all running on this computer.

items.name: Menu bar, options bar and tool column
items.text: File, Edit, Image, Layer, Select, Filter, View, Window and Help, each item with its usual shortcut; the options bar shows the current tool's settings

items.name: Tool groups
items.text: tools with more in their group cycle with Shift and their key, or open with a right-click or long-press

items.name: Command palette
items.text: type part of a command and press Enter

items.name: Keyboard shortcuts list
items.text: every key in one list

items.name: Full screen
items.text: the editor fills the space between bitGen's own bars; its status line moves into bitGen's status bar

items.name: Show or hide panels
items.text: Tab hides every panel, Shift+Tab only the panel groups

items.name: Documents
items.text: every New or Open is its own document with its own layers, undo, selection, paths, channels and zoom

items.name: Tabs and floating windows
items.text: the first document docks as a tab, the next ones float in their own windows; drag between the two

items.name: Close and arrange documents
items.text: Close and Close All ask about unsaved changes; tile, cascade, consolidate to tabs, next and previous document

items.name: Panel groups
items.text: Color and Swatches; Properties, Adjustments, AI and Control; Layers, Paths, Channels, History, Actions and Comps; plus the Character, Paragraph, Sketch, 3D, Body and Unreal tabs

items.name: Floating panel groups
items.text: every tab group floats with its float button and docks back into the column

items.name: The column is a docker
items.text: drop a floating group above or below another (an orange line shows where); the column's width drags from 200 to 640 px

items.name: Named dockers in the editor
items.text: dock floating groups as tabs in a docker you name

items.name: The property bar
items.text: X, Y, W and H of the picked layer with a proportion lock; rectangle corner radii; a vector shape's outline width and line style

items.name: History
items.text: the last 80 steps; click one to go back or forward to it

items.name: Editor settings
items.text: AI results, context, feather, megapixels, what Apply does, the look, rulers, panels and the options bar
items.where: the settings button, or Edit > Preferences (Ctrl+,)

items.name: Pixel, fill, text and shape layers
items.text: solid colour or gradient fills, editable text and shapes

items.name: Adjustment layers
items.text: 16 kinds (Brightness/Contrast, Levels, Curves, Exposure, Vibrance, Hue/Saturation, Color Balance, Black & White, Photo Filter, Channel Mixer, Color Lookup, Gradient Map, Selective Color, Invert, Posterize, Threshold), live in Properties

items.name: Groups
items.text: Ctrl+G groups, Shift+Ctrl+G ungroups; Pass Through lets a group's adjustments reach the layers under it

items.name: Layer masks
items.text: paint on the mask, Alt-click to view it, Shift-click to disable it, Ctrl-click to load it as a selection; density, feather, invert, apply

items.name: Clipping
items.text: a layer shows only where the layer below has pixels

items.name: Fill opacity, locks and labels
items.text: fill opacity dims pixels but not styles; lock transparency, pixels, position or all; colour labels from the right-click menu

items.name: Arrange and merge
items.text: move layers up and down, Merge Down, Merge Visible, Flatten Image, Rasterize

items.name: Layer comps
items.text: keep the layers' visibility, position and appearance, switch between comps, update one, or go back to the last document state

items.name: Delete a layer
items.text: Del deletes the current layer (or clears a selection); Shift+Del always deletes the layer

items.name: No tool
items.text: Esc puts the tools down (nothing picked); a click picks an object, Shift or Ctrl adds it

items.name: The selection box
items.text: with no tool, drag a dashed box: left to right picks the layers wholly inside it, right to left the ones it touches; Shift adds

items.name: Several layers at once
items.text: Shift-click picks every layer between two, Ctrl-click adds or takes one away; the Move tool moves them together and Del deletes them all

items.name: Group and delete picked layers
items.text: with several layers picked, Ctrl+G puts them in one group (Ctrl+G on one group ungroups it), and the 🗑 button deletes them all

items.name: Drop as a layer or a new document
items.text: a picture dropped on an open canvas asks: add it as a layer or open it as a new document

items.name: Generate = a new layer
items.text: in image-edit mode a generated picture always comes in as a new layer, with the style picked in the prompt docker (Krea 2 and every other style are listed for Generate)
items.where: the prompt docker in image-edit mode

items.name: Seamless fill
items.text: a selection is filled with the prompt docker's style through its own graph (the picture encoded + a noise mask + differential diffusion), so it blends like the Krita AI plugin; Krea 2, Klein and the others can fill now
items.where: the image editor with a selection, Generate / Refine

items.name: Transform with skew; Move after Paste
items.text: Ctrl+T (or ⤡ Transform on the Move tool's bar) scales, rotates and skews (Ctrl + an edge); Paste drops the selection so the Move tool moves the pasted layer

items.name: Skew from the middle handles
items.text: Free Transform's middle handles skew the layer (a skew cursor), Shift / Alt + a middle handle stretches

items.name: Fill like the Krita AI plugin
items.text: more context around a selection, the selection pre-filled from its border, a soft mask, a start at 0.9 for models not trained to inpaint
items.where: the image editor with a selection

items.name: Fill and Edit from the Krita plugin's own code
items.text: Generate at full strength, a small region rendered bigger, the mask sized by the selection, a blend past the edge with a colour match, Edit in a selection changes only the selection
items.where: the image editor with a selection

items.name: Fill with the edit model
items.text: Generate / Remove / New background in a selection through the edit model (the selection painted green + Krita's instruction), so the new part belongs in the scene; ▾ Edit keeps to the selection, or to the layer's own pixels
items.where: the image editor's ✨ AI panel (👁), the prompt docker

items.name: Generate fits the selection
items.text: a style that cannot see around a selection makes its picture at the selection's own box, so what it draws is the selection's size
items.where: the image editor's ✨ AI panel (👁 off), the prompt docker

items.name: The Krita AI plugin's fill per model family
items.text: SDXL / Pony with the Fooocus inpaint patch, Illustrious / SD 1.5 / FLUX.1 with inpainting ControlNets, Remove with MAT / LaMa first, Krita's context bounds and its Add content / Fill modes

items.name: ⏳ Pending

items.where: the image editor (⏳ Pending in the ✨ AI panel)

items.name: Any floating docker in the panel column

items.name: References in every ✨ mode
items.text: "picture N" in the prompt brings the References docker's picture to Edit, Generate, Fill, Remove, Refine (through the edit model); "ref N" in Compose
items.where: the image editor's ✨ AI panel, the prompt docker

items.name: AI fill models add-on
items.text: the node pack + the Fooocus / MAT / inpainting ControlNet files for the Krita-way fill, ticked and downloaded from Settings ▸ Add-ons

items.name: ▣ dockers take every docker
items.text: in the floating band with the other floating dockers (not on top of all), outlined while a docker is dragged; Settings, References, Assets, Queue, Gallery and the StoryBoard drag in by their title bar

items.name: Folder filters remember their folder; Basic Settings in basic.cfg
items.text: each folder filter dropdown keeps the folder you picked (folder_filters.cfg); Basic Settings are saved to basic.cfg when changed and read back at the start

items.name: ▣ dockers dock, and every docker goes in
